Got the monthly subscription then switched to yearly in a week since I’ll be keeping this.

title: Elegant app
body: I downloaded 4 of the App Store habit trackers all at once and plugged my daily stationary bike goal into each one. By day 3, this is the last one standing. I added a second habit of eating 5x fruits and vegetables in and I’m loving checking off each time to see the progress wheel light up that much more. I deleted the others and subscribed to this one. I love the elegance of it. It’s got like a retro vibe with the binary dots that fill up. And I gotta say that there were no ads, and the free version was absolutely useable. I mostly subscribed to be supportive because I know I’m going to use this a lot.
